title: qa-verify verify.json — mode=repro-judge (independent reproduction confirmation)
description: The ratified output of the qa-verify skill in mode='repro-judge', written to <repro_dir>/judge.json (v1.2.0 — renamed from verify.json so the two qa-verify modes never overwrite each other). The runner returns this object verbatim to the control plane as `judge_evidence`; the control plane branches ONLY on `verdict` and DERIVES reproduced_confirmed from it. The FOUR keys {verdict, confidence, observed_quote, masking_suspected} are REQUIRED; v1.1.0 adds one OPTIONAL additive key, `media` (capture-time evidence URLs) — any OTHER extra key is still a contract violation. The skill MUST NOT emit reproduced_confirmed. This file is the single source of truth for the runner and the control plane. See contracts/README.md. Model expectation: the `models.verifier` tier from stack.config — never trade quality for tokens on a verifier. v1.1.0 (additive, backward-compatible): `media` is OPTIONAL — a v1.0.0 four-key artifact still validates. v1.2.0: verdict gains 'inconclusive' (ran-but-cannot-rule, distinct from the real-negative 'fail') and the artifact moves to judge.json — coordinate with the control plane and the runner (they branch on verdict and read the artifact path).

verdict.description: 'pass' = the bug is real and the symptom independently reproduces; 'fail' = the judge RAN the confirmation and the symptom did NOT occur — a real negative (triage may treat the repro claim as refuted); 'inconclusive' = the judge ran but could NOT determine (ambiguous evidence, surface unreachable, partial observation) — must NOT be treated as a refuted repro; retry or escalate (v1.2.0). A tooling failure that prevents the judge from running at all still writes NO artifact (the runner's missing-artifact ok:false path) — 'inconclusive' is for a judge that ran and cannot rule.

confidence.description: How strongly the independent observation matches the described symptom. Capped < 80 when masking_suspected is true.

observed_quote.description: Verbatim of what the independent judge actually observed — not a paraphrase of the ticket.

masking_suspected.description: True if the symptom may be hidden/suppressed rather than truly absent (swallowed error, suppressed log, loading state hiding the value, success toast over unchanged state).

media.description: OPTIONAL (v1.1.0). Capture-time evidence media uploaded through the evidence_store adapter during verification, each a URL the control plane can fetch directly (Content-Type video/mp4 | image/gif; a signed read URL or a local file:// URL — no Authorization header). Most repro-judge runs read qa-repro's existing recording and emit NO media; when the judge records a live re-observation it uploads it (the build under judgement is still buggy, so those are 'before-*'). fix-verify's fixed media is 'after-*' (shared four-kind enum). BEST-EFFORT and NEVER required — a v1.0.0 four-key artifact still validates.

kind.description: Which recording this is. repro-judge (buggy build) emits 'before-*'; fix-verify (fixed build) emits 'after-*'.

url.description: The URL exactly as the evidence_store adapter returned it (a signed read URL, or a local file:// URL from the `local` provider). Fetchable with no Authorization header.

label.description: OPTIONAL human label, e.g. 'Verified fixed (after) — MP4'.
